title: Large language models for multimodal clinical predictive modeling: a systematic review
research_problem: How can LLMs combine unstructured clinical text with structured EHR variables for patient-level prediction, and which integration strategies are supported by the literature?
ai_method: Systematic evidence synthesis separating note embeddings, variable extraction and text-fusion approaches to LLM-enabled multimodal EHR prediction.
study_summary: The 57 included studies used three integration patterns; the reported average improvement over single-modality comparators was 6.4%, with differing sample sizes and evaluation conventions.

title: A hybrid framework for Turner Syndrome facial detection: integrating deep feature learning and geometric prior knowledge under data scarcity
research_problem: Can facial screening identify Turner syndrome under limited training data by combining learned appearance with clinically motivated facial geometry?
ai_method: Deep facial features are fused with geometric priors and classified in the combined representation; prospective external testing follows retrospective development.
study_summary: The external cohort yielded 95.41% accuracy, 96.55% sensitivity and 95.24% specificity. The reported 100% sensitivity concerns a difficulty-stratified training experiment, not all diagnostic settings.

title: OpenDVP: an experimental and computational framework for community-empowered deep visual proteomics
research_problem: Can a reusable open workflow connect spatial cell phenotypes to proteomic measurements in archival tissue?
ai_method: openDVP links MCMICRO/QuPath/napari image processing and AI segmentation with laser-capture proteomics, AnnData and SpatialData. It offers both simpler and AI-enabled workflows.
study_summary: Three tissue applications connect cell neighborhoods with proteomic differences; the breast-cancer analysis resolves primary and recurrent tumor microenvironments. The contribution is an interoperable experimental-analysis workflow.

title: Multi-site real-world performance of commercial AI for pulmonary and incidental pulmonary embolism detection
research_problem: How accurately do deployed commercial algorithms detect dedicated and incidental pulmonary emboli across routine CT examinations, including subtle embolus subtypes?
ai_method: Retrospective post-market evaluation of two Aidoc detection algorithms, with report-derived reference labels extracted by a separately validated LLM pipeline.
study_summary: Dedicated-PE sensitivity/specificity were 86.8%/99.1%; incidental-PE values were 73.5%/99.8%. Sensitivity was lower for peripheral and non-acute emboli than for central acute disease.

title: A Generative AI-powered navigation system for precision CBCT-guided lung biopsies: a randomized controlled trial
research_problem: Does generative image enhancement integrated with puncture navigation improve the efficiency and safety of CBCT-guided lung biopsy?
ai_method: GPS-Lung combines generative CBCT image improvement with procedure navigation; retrospective development is followed by a multicenter randomized biopsy comparison.
study_summary: In the analyzed randomized groups, GPS-Lung reduced punctures, procedure time and radiation exposure. Pneumothorax occurred in 12.7% versus 23.9%.

title: Towards reliable morphological subtyping and cancer detection on Barrett’s esophagus pathology through ensembling foundation models

title: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
research_problem: Do automated similarity metrics measure clinical message quality, or primarily how faithfully clinicians edit the AI draft they can see?
ai_method: A staged GPT-draft rollout compares displayed-and-edited drafts with silently generated drafts; lexical/semantic metrics are checked against blinded physician ratings.
study_summary: BERTScore was 0.93 for incorporated drafts and 0.83 for independently written messages, but its correlation with clinical ratings depended on whether clinicians saw the draft. Human-authored messages were preferred in the blinded assessment.

primary_findings: Automated tasks and expert/user assessments evaluate factual knowledge, interpretation, symptoms and coaching. The study shows a concrete architecture and broad benchmark coverage, rather than a clinical-outcome benefit.
limitations: Benchmark ratings and simulated/user conversations are not a patient treatment RCT. Access differs between released benchmark subsets and the full WEAR-ME cohort.

title: HRDPath: an explainable multi-model deep learning architecture for predicting homologous recombination deficiency from histopathology images
research_problem: Can routine ovarian-cancer histology predict homologous-recombination deficiency without additional molecular testing?
ai_method: HRDPath aggregates information across patient whole-slide images using multiple deep models and adds an interpretability pipeline for HRD-associated morphology.
study_summary: Across three cohorts, the reported AUC is 0.846. Multi-slide aggregation and optimization yield operating points with sensitivity and specificity of 0.90, suggesting an image-derived HRD biomarker.

title: Expertise modulates automation bias and sentinel behavior in human–AI collaborative diagnosis of neonatal pneumoperitoneum
research_problem: How do clinician expertise and deliberately flawed AI suggestions change diagnostic resilience when reading neonatal pneumoperitoneum radiographs?
ai_method: A crossover reader experiment compares unaided interpretation, reliable AI and error-injected AI, assessing acceptance and override of algorithmic errors.
study_summary: Trainees accepted 52.0% of incorrect suggestions under reliable AI. Three neonatologists overrode 91.7% of errors under flawed AI; this small specialist subgroup supports a hypothesis rather than a general clinical guarantee.

title: GUARD-LGG: a glioma upfront AI-driven radiotherapy response decipher for lower-grade glioma
research_problem: Can pretreatment imaging and clinical features identify lower-grade glioma patients likely to respond poorly to radiotherapy?
ai_method: GUARD-LGG combines radiomic and clinical predictors, with internal, multicenter external and separately recruited prospective testing plus exploratory radiogenomics.
study_summary: Reported AUCs were 0.946 in training, 0.929 internally, 0.882 externally and 0.913 in the prospective test set. Predicted unfavorable response also tracked shorter survival.

title: Engineered human Argonaute 2 for targeted C-to-U RNA base editing
research_problem: Can human AGO2 provide programmable RNA editing with less predicted immunogenicity than foreign-protein editors?
ai_method: AGO2 is engineered into the ALTER RNA editor; machine-learning immunogenic-peptide prediction and an AI deimmunization workflow assess and refine its protein scaffold.
study_summary: In HEK293T cells, mean target editing is 1.9 times that of the compared Cas13 editors, with similar or lower transcriptome-wide off-target editing. ML predicts fewer immunogenic peptides.

title: High-risk antimicrobial resistance genomic traits in multidrug-resistant Salmonella across China’s food chain: projections to 2050
research_problem: Which resistance traits in multidrug-resistant Salmonella are associated with environmental and socioeconomic conditions, and how might their prevalence change?
ai_method: A machine-learning surveillance/risk framework combines resistance-genome features with source, climate, healthcare, antibiotic-use and socioeconomic indicators; regression supports scenario projections.
study_summary: The analysis identifies 84 high-risk resistance traits and projects heterogeneous changes through 2050, including increasing plasmid-mediated fluoroquinolone resistance and food-worker reservoir signals.

title: Reinforcement learning for repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation protocol selection in treatment-resistant depression
research_problem: Can an offline learned policy identify session-level rTMS choices associated with improved depression symptoms in held-out clinics?
ai_method: Reinforcement learning uses longitudinal clinical decisions and subsequent PHQ-9 change to recommend stimulation type, intensity and laterality; policy value is assessed observationally.
study_summary: Matching recommendations was associated with 0.788 points greater next-session improvement in held-out clinics. The projected 3.22-point episode benefit is a model-based estimate, not an observed randomized treatment effect.

title: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
research_problem: Can a one-year OUD risk model transfer across changing EHR vocabularies and independent national healthcare systems?
ai_method: OUD-REY learns longitudinal EHR histories and uses pretrained language representations to harmonize previously unseen clinical features across datasets.
study_summary: Internal AUROC was 0.912; temporal All of Us and VA validation AUROCs were 0.864 and 0.855, with substantially lower precision-recall values under their low OUD prevalences.

title: AI-supported first consultation preparation in oncology: a real-world clinical usability study
research_problem: Does an LLM-generated preparation summary reduce perceived workload when clinicians prepare real oncology consultations?
ai_method: AI-FCP structures unstructured documentation; a prospective single-group pre/post usability study combines clinician-level baselines and consultation-level follow-up.
study_summary: Perceived workload fell by 28.9%, with self-reported savings of 3.26 minutes per case. Preparation succeeded in 84.9% of consultations, and 63.6% of summaries were complete.

title: Large language models for depression assessment from brief daily diaries
research_problem: Do LLM scores from brief daily video diaries capture depression variation beyond self-report surveys?
ai_method: LLMs rate transcribed diaries; multilevel and multivariable analyses compare within-person changes and person-level averages against surveys, interviews and daily functioning.

title: Automated differentiation for parkinsonism using clinical structural MRI: A multicenter study
research_problem: Can routine structural MRI distinguish parkinsonian disorders without the acquisition burden of research-grade multimodal imaging?
ai_method: A hierarchical discovery/verification/translation pipeline derives a T1-Top20 machine-learning signature, freezes it for external testing and transfers it to anisotropic clinical MRI.
study_summary: The T1 model achieved multiclass AUROC 0.93, external PD-versus-MSA AUROC 0.88 and clinical-MRI AUROC 0.84; it identified 19 of 25 observed iRBD phenoconverters.

title: A multi-stage validation framework for trustworthy large-scale clinical information extraction using large language models
research_problem: How can LLM-extracted substance-use diagnoses be checked at scale when exhaustive expert annotation is impractical?
ai_method: Prompt calibration, structural filtering, semantic grounding, judge-LLM review, expert checks and downstream predictive validity form a staged weak-supervision validation pipeline.
study_summary: Filtering removed 14.59% of initially positive extractions. The primary extractor achieved F1 0.80 against judge evaluations, and extracted diagnoses predicted subsequent specialty care beyond structured-code baselines.

title: Tryptoline stereoprobe elaboration identifies inhibitors of the GRPEL1–HSPA9 complex
research_problem: Predicting nonorthosteric covalent ligand binding and identifying mitochondrial chaperone-system inhibitors.
ai_method: Boltz-2 protein–ligand cofolding predictions are compared with experimentally mapped stereoprobe interactions.
study_summary: Chemoproteomics identifies GRPEL1 ligands that disrupt GRPEL1–HSPA9 function. The cofolding analysis reveals failures to place many nonorthosteric ligands correctly, providing an experimentally grounded limitation test for AI-assisted ligand modeling.

title: Fluke-borne viruses are a risk factor and diagnostic target for diseases caused by carcinogenic trematodes
research_problem: Identifying liver-fluke-associated fibrosis and cholangiocarcinoma using host responses to fluke-borne viruses.
ai_method: Random-forest classification using serological measurements.
study_summary: Combines viral and serological evidence with learned classifiers that distinguish infected participants without overt disease from those with periductal fibrosis or cholangiocarcinoma. Predictive discrimination does not establish a clinical screening benefit.

title: LitGene: an interpretable transformer model integrating text and ontology for gene representation learning
research_problem: Can text descriptions and gene ontology improve interpretable gene representations and disease-gene hypothesis generation?
ai_method: LitGene uses a transformer and contrastive learning to align literature text with Gene Ontology; SHAP and literature grounding explain prediction features.
study_summary: Across eight protein-property tasks it achieves competitive performance and supports zero-shot ontology, pathway and gene-disease predictions. ANGPTL6 is highlighted for IPF with independent expression support.

title: TrajOnco: a multi-agent framework for temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHR for multi-cancer early detection
research_problem: Can training-free agent collaboration reason over years of EHR events to estimate near-term risk for multiple cancers?
ai_method: TrajOnco chains LLM agents with long-term memory to summarize temporal events, cite evidence and estimate one-year cancer risk; matched case-control tests compare with single-agent and supervised baselines.
study_summary: Across 15 cancers AUROCs ranged from 0.64 to 0.80; temporal reasoning improved over single-agent configurations, with interpretable but imperfect rationales.

title: Solving operating room scheduling problems using large language model based multi-agent architecture
research_problem: Can collaborating LLM agents generate optimization code that produces feasible, efficient operating-room schedules?
ai_method: Specialized iterative agents formulate and revise mixed-integer scheduling code, with synthetic scenarios, real surgical datasets and expert-written optimization comparators.
study_summary: Average feasible-schedule rates were 82.91% for the iterative system versus 65.59% and 52.53% for baselines; generated solutions approached expert-programmed optimization performance.

title: An artificial intelligence framework for end-to-end rare disease phenotyping from clinical notes using large language models
research_problem: Can an end-to-end system extract, standardize and prioritize rare-disease phenotypes from clinical notes rather than optimizing these steps separately?
ai_method: RARE-PHENIX combines LLM extraction, ontology-grounded HPO standardization and supervised phenotype ranking, followed by independent clinical-note evaluation.
study_summary: The pipeline improved concordance with curated HPO profiles and provided exploratory downstream disease-prioritization signal; the clinically diagnosed subset was much smaller than the note corpus.

title: Spatiotemporal AI-based modeling of gene regulation and variant effects in the developing human brain using Seal

title: HDOCK-Multimer: improved structure prediction of large protein complexes by integrating docking and combinatorial assembly
research_problem: Can docking-assisted assembly improve large protein-complex prediction when subcomponent predictions are imperfect?
ai_method: HDOCK-Multimer combines docking with combinatorial assembly of predicted subcomponents and uses normalized structural scoring to rank assemblies and stoichiometries.
study_summary: Across three benchmarks it improves large-complex modeling relative to the compared assembly/AlphaFold pipelines; scoring also supports stoichiometry inference without a fixed input stoichiometry.

title: Sequence models reveal diagnosis accumulation pathways beyond comorbidity burden in population-scale hospital data
research_problem: Do the order, recency and speed of hospital diagnoses add prognostic information beyond age and aggregate comorbidity burden?
ai_method: A contrastively trained visit-level transformer encodes diagnosis sequences and admission timing; embeddings are compared with Elixhauser-based risk models across mortality and disease outcomes.
study_summary: Mortality AUC increased from 0.866 to 0.879; gains across incident conditions were modest and heterogeneous. Residual embedding risk separated subsequent event-free survival among otherwise similar patients.

research_question: Can a learned microexon sequence code identify regulatory variants associated with autism?
ai_approach: Transcriptome profiling expands microexon annotations; sequence-based machine learning identifies splice-regulatory elements and scores variant effects on neuronal microexon inclusion.
primary_findings: The study finds additional microexons and identifies rare autism-associated variants predicted to disrupt their regulation, including convergent synaptic-gene signals.
limitations: Variant association and predicted splicing effects are distinct from causal confirmation of each autism variant. Family/genomic analyses and cultured-neuron assays have separate denominators.

title: Small viruses reveal bidirectional evolution between HK97-fold viruses and encapsulins via procapsids
research_problem: Can protein-sequence models reveal simpler HK97-fold viruses that bridge viral capsids and encapsulins?
ai_method: Hidden Markov models and protein language models search public metagenomes; structural and phylogenetic analyses characterize newly identified small viral genomes.
study_summary: Small genomes encode encapsulin-like HK97-fold proteins without typical portal/tail genes. Their relationships support an evolutionary model involving viral procapsid intermediates and bidirectional transitions.

title: A multiview video–text model detects obstructive coronary stenosis and predicts 1-year cardiovascular events from angiography
research_problem: Whole-study coronary stenosis assessment and cardiovascular prognosis from multiview angiography.
ai_method: DeepCORO-CLIP video–text learning across complete angiographic studies.
study_summary: Retrospective multicenter evaluation supports stenosis detection and one-year risk prediction. Generated reports were usable in many blinded reviews but remained below cardiologist reports, so automated deployment benefits are not established.

research_question: Can one restoration model handle diverse medical-image degradations while retaining diagnostically useful information?
ai_approach: AMIFound uses a shared encoder and dynamically routed restoration experts across imaging modalities and degradation types.
primary_findings: It outperforms 38 compared baselines on image metrics, clinician assessment and robustness tests; restored images improve multiple disease-detection tasks and NSCLC stage/survival analyses.
limitations: Enhancement metrics and retrospective downstream tests do not establish patient-outcome benefit or guarantee fidelity for unseen scanner/degradation conditions.

title: Model-dependent prompt effects challenge reliable deployment of medical LLMs in traditional Chinese medicine
research_problem: How strongly do prompt strategies and model choice interact when LLMs answer traditional Chinese medicine licensing questions?
ai_method: Sixteen LLMs are tested under seven prompting strategies using a public examination benchmark, with paired prompt analysis and focused error classification.
study_summary: Unprompted accuracy ranged from 35.4% to 85.9%; average prompt gains were small, while individual models sometimes improved markedly or deteriorated. No prompt reliably helped all models.

title: Development of a scoring system via an interpretable end-to-end neural network for prognostic stratification of patients with advanced melanoma
research_problem: Can an interpretable neural scoring system stratify advanced-melanoma prognosis across treatment regimens and independent trials?
ai_method: ScoreNet learns an additive, eight-feature risk score for overall and progression-free survival, then checks stratification in separate trial datasets.
study_summary: The score separated low-, intermediate- and high-risk groups across multiple treatment classes and retained prognostic stratification in two external trials.

title: Multidimensional continuous glucose monitoring metrics enable digital risk stratification across the diabetes spectrum
research_problem: Can multidimensional CGM patterns reveal diabetes subtypes and complication risks that conventional time-in-range measures miss?
ai_method: The study combines CGM-derived metrics, Gaussian-mixture phenotyping and predictive glycemic risk scoring within the iCanNet cohort.
study_summary: Distinct diabetes signatures and four T2D phenotypes emerged. The risk score reassigned some conventionally well-controlled patients to higher complication-risk groups.

title: AEGIS: an operational infrastructure for post-market governance of adaptive medical AI under US and EU regulatory frameworks
research_problem: Can operational governance logic route retraining and post-market model updates to explicit approval, review or rejection states?
ai_method: AEGIS joins data assimilation, retraining, monitoring and conditional decisions, instantiated with sepsis prediction and brain-tumor segmentation plus constructed failure scenarios.
study_summary: Experiments exercised all decision categories and routed unsafe/no-deployable-model states to rejection with alarm. Cross-site covariate-shift discrimination improved, but concept drift was not evaluated.

title: Human–artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time
research_problem: Can patients interact with an EEG-linked AI system and use their feedback to improve seizure alerts?
ai_method: A secure LLM conversation layer combines sleep, medication, cognition and seizure-probability biomarkers with scalp/intracranial EEG classifiers; patient feedback fine-tunes seizure detection.
study_summary: Inpatient use produced 1,307 exchanged messages. A pseudoprospective simulation improves seizure-detector precision using patient feedback without expert relabeling.

research_question: Can patients interact with an EEG-linked AI system and use their feedback to improve seizure alerts?
ai_approach: A secure LLM conversation layer combines sleep, medication, cognition and seizure-probability biomarkers with scalp/intracranial EEG classifiers; patient feedback fine-tunes seizure detection.
primary_findings: Inpatient use produced 1,307 exchanged messages. A pseudoprospective simulation improves seizure-detector precision using patient feedback without expert relabeling.
limitations: This is a small inpatient feasibility study plus a pseudoprospective detector simulation, not a randomized demonstration of fewer seizures or better long-term outcomes.
boundary: This is a small inpatient feasibility study plus a pseudoprospective detector simulation, not a randomized demonstration of fewer seizures or better long-term outcomes.
data_availability_summary: De-identified EEG/annotations are deposited on Pennsieve. Free-text chats are restricted; qualified researchers need review and a data-use agreement. Full replication also needs proprietary streaming software/cloud configuration.
code_availability_summary: A code-availability section is present; use the linked repositories and licensing terms.

title: Repurposing adult AI radiograph models for neonatal care through continual learning: an international multicentre study
research_problem: Can sequential learning adapt adult radiograph AI to neonatal tube assessment without pooling patient images?
ai_method: Continual learning updates an adult endotracheal-tube/landmark model sequentially on small hospital-specific neonatal datasets and compares it with local fine-tuning and the adult model.
study_summary: Mean localization error falls to 0.67 cm versus 1.29 cm for local fine-tuning and 4.30 cm for the adult-only model; most sites improve deep-intubation detection.

title: Advancing chemical reaction prediction in data-scarce drug discovery with active and geometric deep learning
research_problem: Can actively chosen reactions and geometric learning improve synthesis predictions when drug-optimization data are scarce?
ai_method: A tree-ensemble active learner chooses informative C–H borylation experiments; symmetry-aware graph neural networks with auxiliary self-supervision predict reaction yield/outcome and regioselectivity.
study_summary: Three active-learning rounds expand the borylation benchmark. Prospective unseen N-heteroaryl examples have their borylation positions correctly predicted; a separate Minisci dataset broadens evaluation.

title: AI-assisted scoping review of code sharing in clinical prediction model research
research_problem: How often does clinical prediction-model research share usable analytical code, beyond merely mentioning a repository?
ai_method: An LLM-assisted scoping pipeline screens TRIPOD-citing papers, extracts code repositories and assesses 14 reproducibility features.
study_summary: Only 482 of 3,967 articles include code-sharing statements. Repository features vary considerably, indicating that code links alone do not ensure executable/reusable analyses.

title: AI-assisted telerehabilitation in early Parkinson’s disease: a multicenter, randomized, multi-arm comparative trial
research_problem: Does longer AI-assisted home rehabilitation improve early Parkinson motor outcomes?
ai_method: A randomized, rater-blinded comparison assigns 120 patients to one-, two- or three-month telerehabilitation schedules.
study_summary: Only 71 entered final analysis; the primary motor endpoint did not differ, and a cognitive responder signal was exploratory.

research_problem: What diagnostic-error levels do members of the public consider acceptable for medical AI?

research_question: Can openly available medical vision-language models improve data-efficient adaptation across medical image and text tasks?

title: Highly multiplexed mammalian metabolic engineering with a shotgun approach
research_problem: Can many barcoded small DNA constructs make combinatorial metabolic engineering tractable in mammalian cells?
ai_method: Shotgun genetic engineering samples pathway content, dosage and organellar localization in single cells; machine learning links construct features to biosynthetic phenotypes.
study_summary: Screening yields CHO and Jurkat pathways supporting growth without selected essential amino acids. Mitochondrial localization and large synthetic-DNA payloads emerge as useful design features.

title: Decoding systemic vascular health and hypertensive disorders in pregnancy through retinal imaging and Visionary AI
research_problem: Can early-pregnancy retinal vascular structure predict hypertensive pregnancy disorders before symptoms?
ai_method: Visionary AI converts retinal vessels into graph-derived topology/geometry features, fits interpretable risk models and transfers a stability-optimized model without retraining.
study_summary: Preeclampsia AUC is 0.91 in the development setting and 0.81 externally, with corresponding AP values 0.81 and 0.68. Retinal network features connect prediction to systemic vascular biology.

title: CellART: a unified framework for extracting single-cell information from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics
research_problem: Can images, spatial transcripts and reference RNA profiles jointly recover reliable cells across high-resolution spatial platforms?
ai_method: CellART combines deep image analysis and probabilistic modeling to jointly segment cells and assign types using staining, spatial counts and scRNA-seq references.
study_summary: Evaluations across high-resolution platforms show a unified route to cell-level outputs compatible with common downstream tools.

research_question: Can mass-spectrometric profiles be classified directly, avoiding a full protein-identification workflow?
ai_approach: ProFormer is a transformer over tabular MS1 peptide-ion features, with peptide-level interpretability and comparisons against conventional ML/CNN architectures.
primary_findings: Across cell-line, single-cell and plasma tasks it improves classification/generalization over the evaluated alternatives, including cell identity/state and disease-status discrimination.
limitations: Architecture comparisons and dataset shifts differ across tasks. Patient disease classification does not establish a prospective diagnostic workflow; cell counts used to prepare samples are not numbers of independent patients.

title: Benchmarking imputation methods on real-world clinical time series with simulated spatio-temporal missingness
research_problem: Do complex imputers remain advantageous when missing clinical observations have realistic time/feature structure?
ai_method: A Markov-chain missingness simulator creates joint spatiotemporal patterns in three clinical datasets; LOCF, interpolation and spatiotemporal autoencoders are compared, including downstream prediction.
study_summary: Deep autoencoders lead under unstructured missingness, but linear interpolation performs best under structured patterns and supports adequate downstream prediction.

title: Brain signatures of body mass index predict cardiometabolic and respiratory disease status
research_problem: Can brain MRI encode body-mass-associated changes relevant to non-neurological disease?

study_summary: Within-cohort prediction exceeded external performance; brain-derived signatures discriminated cardiometabolic and respiratory conditions beyond BMI itself.

title: Multimodal computational analysis of longitudinal stress profiles in healthcare workers
research_problem: Can brief stress narratives distinguish sustained vulnerability among healthcare workers?
ai_method: A hierarchical transformer fuses linguistic, acoustic and facial embeddings against longitudinal symptom clusters.
study_summary: Of 750 invited workers, 553 contributed sufficient data; multimodal held-out AUC was 0.75 versus 0.63 for language alone.

title: Clinician-centered evaluation of large language model-generated discharge summaries for longer hospitalizations
research_problem: Do LLM discharge summaries preserve information important to receiving clinicians after longer admissions?
ai_method: Paired clinician review compares generated and human summaries for 60 hospitalizations lasting 7–21 days.
study_summary: Reviewers preferred AI summaries in 95% of encounters and annotated fewer omissions, without significant differences in estimated harm.

title: Machine Learning Model Predicts Three Year Mortality in Cardiovascular Kidney Metabolic Syndrome
research_problem: Can a compact predictor stratify three-year mortality in cardiovascular–kidney–metabolic syndrome?
ai_method: XGBoost and LASSO are developed on 101 variables, yielding an eight-variable boosting model.
study_summary: Among 219,561 hospitalized patients, center-based validation AUC was 0.813 and high-score groups had substantially higher mortality.

title: A model of brain function to predict tau across Alzheimer’s disease and related disorders
research_problem: Can FDG-PET and a brain-function model estimate AD-type tau when tau-PET is unavailable?
ai_method: Machine learning combines FDG metabolic imaging with a computational model of brain function to predict participant-level flortaucipir-PET patterns.
study_summary: Predicted tau explains roughly 0.34–0.71 of participant-level variation and classifies low/high tau stages with 79–95% accuracy across the reported settings.

title: Function-preserving watermarking of AI-generated proteins
research_problem: Can provenance watermarks be embedded in designed proteins and predicted structures without destroying useful function?
ai_method: SynthIDBio-sequence constrains protein generation to encode a detectable watermark; SynthIDBio-structure fine-tunes AlphaFold3 to mark biomolecular coordinates.
study_summary: Designed binders retain affinities comparable with unwatermarked controls while sequence watermark detection is nearly perfect in the reported tests; structural marking supplies a second provenance route.

title: Strabismus-Net mobile application for nine-gaze photograph-based strabismus diagnosis using dual-stream cross-attention and adaptive feature aggregation
research_problem: Can gaze photographs support both home strabismus screening and community-level subtype diagnosis?
ai_method: A dual-stream, cross-attention network combines adaptive features from nine gaze directions.
study_summary: Development used 84,897 photographs from 9,433 people; prospective testing used 10,458 photographs from 1,162 people, with subtype-dependent accuracy.

title: Development and validation of a machine learning model for the preoperative prediction of intractable hypoxemia in repeat lung surgery
research_problem: Can prior and current surgical measurements identify hypoxemia risk before repeat lung resection?
ai_method: Nineteen learners and feature-selection procedures yield a five-variable MARS model combining CT and clinical information.
study_summary: Across 2,040 patients from seven hospitals, validation AUCs were approximately 0.75–0.78, outperforming pulmonary-function-only models.

title: Blind spots in AI-assisted healthcare evidence search: multiplatform evaluation of clinical retrieval gaps and risk-of-bias
research_problem: Do common AI evidence-search tools systematically miss clinically relevant literature?
ai_method: Five platforms are tested across 15 query formulations against a prospectively assembled non-public reference corpus.
study_summary: Single-query recall was limited; 12% of evidence was never retrieved, with particularly poor coverage of conference proceedings.

title: Generalizable CT vision-language modeling for population health and disease risk

ai_method: Percival contrastively aligns CT scans and reports, comparing embeddings with vision-only and segmentation-based approaches.
study_summary: Training exceeded 400,000 CT-report pairs; over 20,000 held-out participants supported clinical associations and disease/risk analyses.

title: Guiding large language models to predict edit sequences for molecular synthesizability optimization
research_problem: Can LLM-guided small structural edits rescue synthesizability while preserving molecular pharmacophores?

study_summary: Benchmarks improve synthesizable-analogue generation while retaining structure; PLK1, RIPK1 and SARS-CoV-2 protease case studies illustrate candidate rescue.

title: AI-based characterization of Alzheimer’s disease phenotypes from population-scale single-cell data
research_problem: Which cell states associate with distinct clinical and neuropathological Alzheimer phenotypes?
ai_method: PASCode ensembles statistical phenotype-association signals inside a graph neural model to score cells and build a phenotype-linked single-cell atlas.
study_summary: It prioritizes microglial, astrocytic and neuronal subpopulations and pathways, with external population-scale AD/depression validation and an interactive community resource.

research_question: Which cell states associate with distinct clinical and neuropathological Alzheimer phenotypes?
ai_approach: PASCode ensembles statistical phenotype-association signals inside a graph neural model to score cells and build a phenotype-linked single-cell atlas.
primary_findings: It prioritizes microglial, astrocytic and neuronal subpopulations and pathways, with external population-scale AD/depression validation and an interactive community resource.
limitations: Phenotype-associated cells are inferred from observational postmortem data; their abundance and expression do not establish causal disease mechanisms or diagnostic accuracy in living patients.

title: Personalized single-cell transcriptomics reveals molecular diversity in Alzheimer’s disease
research_problem: Can donor-specific regulatory networks explain molecular heterogeneity and phenotypic differences in Alzheimer disease?
ai_method: iBrainMap uses knowledge-guided graph neural networks to embed donor-level cell interactions and gene regulation; graph attention prioritizes personalized features and regulatory QTLs.
study_summary: Cross-cohort analyses classify AD phenotypes, identify molecular subgroups and model progression-related trajectories while linking genetic variants to regulatory differences.

research_question: Can donor-specific regulatory networks explain molecular heterogeneity and phenotypic differences in Alzheimer disease?
ai_approach: iBrainMap uses knowledge-guided graph neural networks to embed donor-level cell interactions and gene regulation; graph attention prioritizes personalized features and regulatory QTLs.
primary_findings: Cross-cohort analyses classify AD phenotypes, identify molecular subgroups and model progression-related trajectories while linking genetic variants to regulatory differences.
limitations: Inferred trajectories and attention scores are observational model outputs, not longitudinal causal histories or proof that highlighted genes are therapeutic targets.

title: NanoTS: a deep learning tool for accurate SNP calling in nanopore long-read transcriptome data
research_problem: Can nanopore RNA reads support accurate SNP and genotype calls despite sequencing errors and allelic imbalance?
ai_method: NanoTS applies deep learning to direct-RNA and cDNA transcriptome reads and evaluates both benchmark SNPs and Mendelian-disease variants.
study_summary: For SNPs with at least five supporting reads, F1 exceeds 0.980 for direct RNA and 0.966 for cDNA; allelically imbalanced variants particularly benefit.

title: Trastuzumab plus nivolumab with gemcitabine and cisplatin as first-line therapy for HER2-positive unresectable biliary tract cancer: a phase 1b/2 trial
research_problem: Does adding HER2 targeting to first-line chemoimmunotherapy show activity in HER2-positive advanced biliary cancer, and which tissue features track benefit?
ai_method: The clinical regimen is evaluated in the single-arm HERBOT trial; a preplanned AI whole-slide analysis quantifies HER2-positive tumor-cell proportions as a correlative biomarker.
study_summary: The objective response rate is 55% and disease control 95%; greater HER2 3+ cell proportions associate with greater benefit in the AI tissue analysis.

title: Large-scale esophageal cancer screening through noncontrast computed tomography and artificial intelligence
research_problem: Can chest noncontrast CT detect otherwise difficult esophageal precancer and early cancer at screening scale?
ai_method: EAGLE learns an imaging detector and is tested across opportunistic CT, low-dose screening, calibration and prospectively enrolled hospital settings.
study_summary: External tests achieve 98.5% specificity with 90.0% cancer sensitivity; prospective hospital PPV is 42.2%, while real-world low-dose screening specificity reaches 99.94%.

research_question: Can chest noncontrast CT detect otherwise difficult esophageal precancer and early cancer at screening scale?
ai_approach: EAGLE learns an imaging detector and is tested across opportunistic CT, low-dose screening, calibration and prospectively enrolled hospital settings.
primary_findings: External tests achieve 98.5% specificity with 90.0% cancer sensitivity; prospective hospital PPV is 42.2%, while real-world low-dose screening specificity reaches 99.94%.
limitations: Different operating points, populations and reference standards produce distinct metrics; they should not be pooled. Prospective model evaluation is not an RCT of screening mortality benefit.

title: Short-term memory of past caspase activity biases cell elimination in vivo
research_problem: Does a cell’s prior sublethal caspase activity influence whether later activation causes apoptosis?
ai_method: Quantitative live imaging, machine-learning analysis and optogenetic manipulation examine caspase thresholds in the Drosophila pupal notum.
study_summary: Cells show heterogeneous death thresholds; prior sublethal exposure increases later apoptosis sensitivity for hours and helps explain spatial patterns of cell elimination.

title: RamanOmics decodes the spatial vibrational–molecular architecture of senescence in aging and repair
research_problem: Identifying cellular senescence without destructive labeling.
ai_method: RamanOmics combines hyperspectral Raman imaging, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics and a learned multimodal barcode.
study_summary: Finds tissue-specific senescence programs and a shared lipid-associated Raman signature in mouse lung, skin and wound repair. The model is a preclinical cellular-state measurement tool.

title: Chemist-aligned retrosynthesis by ensembling diverse inductive bias models
research_problem: Can complementary retrosynthesis models reduce rare-reaction failures and produce plans chemists prefer?
ai_method: RetroChimera combines two models with different inductive biases through a learned ensemble and evaluates reaction-class scarcity, distribution shift and chemist preference.
study_summary: It improves baseline performance, learns rare classes with few examples and transfers to internal datasets from two pharmaceutical companies; chemists prefer its predictions in the reported comparisons.

title: Staged purpose-blinded evaluation of provenance risk from a general-purpose generator in breast ultrasound

title: scTransMIL bridges patient-level disease states and single-cell transcriptomics for cancer screening and heterogeneity inference

study_summary: Predicts sample-level cancer phenotypes and metastatic tissue of origin, while exploring associated cellular populations and progression patterns. Model attention supports hypothesis generation rather than causal biomarker proof.

research_question: Can sequence-derived priors improve regulatory-network inference without matched assays?
ai_approach: GLM-Prior fine-tunes a genomic language model and couples predicted TF-target priors to PMF-GRN.
primary_findings: Cross-species mammalian priors improve inferred networks; performance depends strongly on available labels and TF coverage.
limitations: Reference-network agreement is not causal verification of every regulatory edge, and poorly annotated contexts remain challenging.

title: Clinical usability of an explainable AI decision support tool and evaluation of multimodal models in NSCLC
research_problem: Does explainable AI improve immunotherapy-outcome prediction in NSCLC?
ai_method: I3LUNG tests clinical/blood ML against multimodal fusion and evaluates physician use of the explanation tool.
study_summary: In 2,396 patients, clinical/blood models reach test AUC 0.77; external AUCs fall to 0.55–0.72 and multimodal gains do not consistently transfer.

ai_method: MemBrain-seg learns segmentation, MemBrain-pick combines geometry with deep localization, and MemBrain-stats quantifies organization.
study_summary: The integrated workflow reduces annotation burden across diverse tomographic conditions and provides membrane-particle spatial measurements.

title: Deep learning CT signature for predicting early liver metastases in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
research_problem: Predicting early liver metastasis after pancreatic-cancer diagnosis.
ai_method: Mamba-based CT deep learning combines primary pancreatic-tumor and liver imaging features.
study_summary: A retrospective multicenter cohort supports metastasis-risk discrimination and treatment-response subgroup hypotheses. Associations after propensity matching do not prove that model-guided neoadjuvant treatment improves survival.

title: AI models for medication adherence prediction: closing the gap to clinical readiness
research_problem: Why have medication-adherence predictors struggled to reach clinical readiness?
ai_method: A 41-study systematic review applies PROBAST+AI to development and evaluation methods.
study_summary: Most models raised development-quality concerns, and 80% had high evaluation bias; complexity did not consistently improve discrimination.

title: A foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on noncontrast computed tomography
research_problem: Can noncontrast CT support acute-abdomen diagnosis and triage?
ai_method: AbdomenNet uses self-supervised pretraining, multitask detection and reader comparisons.
study_summary: External evaluation in 2,528 patients yields emergent-condition macro-AUROC 0.919; reconstructed prioritization suggests faster reports.

study_summary: Independent testing in 56 people yielded AUC 0.838; recalibration improved probability reliability without changing discrimination.

research_problem: Can emergency chief-complaint text anticipate lifesaving procedures before hospital arrival?

study_summary: Models trained on approximately 9.2 million encounters transferred to approximately 9.8 million subsequent-year encounters, with category-dependent discrimination.

ai_method: DentFound is an instance-guided vision-language model for diagnosis and report generation.
study_summary: Multicentre experiments and expert ratings indicate broader diagnostic coverage than comparator reports. The cohort covers all dentition stages; report quality is distinct from patient treatment benefit.

title: A foundational model encodes deep phenotyping data and enables diverse downstream applications
research_problem: Can a foundation model connect deep phenotypes to disease subtypes and future risk?
ai_method: ukbFound tokenizes individual traits from 502,118 UK Biobank participants into position-free sequences.
study_summary: It identified prognostically distinct subgroups in 53 of 289 diseases and improved lifestyle-based risk prediction over ten benchmarks; the highest-risk gout group had 17.5-fold greater future odds.

title: Global physician perspectives on artificial intelligence in healthcare across 50 countries and territories
research_problem: What separates physicians’ optimism about AI from actual clinical use?
ai_method: A multilingual cross-sectional survey analyzed 1,049 physicians across 50 countries and territories using regression and group comparisons.

title: Multi-dimensional MRI representation and privileged learning approaches to functional outcome prediction for ischemic stroke patients
research_problem: Can stroke outcome prediction use rich MRI information without requiring every training feature at inference?

title: Clinician engagement shapes the impact of AI-based ECG screening for chronic liver disease in primary care
research_problem: Does clinician engagement influence the yield of AI ECG screening for liver disease?
ai_method: A post hoc analysis compared high- and low-engagement clinicians within the intervention arm of the cluster-randomized DULCE trial.
study_summary: Among 110 clinicians and 1,385 alert-positive patients, high engagement was associated with substantially greater liver-disease detection and diagnostic yield.

title: Impact of artificial intelligence on cardiovascular workflow, engagement, and outcomes: a systematic review
research_problem: Do deployed cardiovascular AI interventions improve workflow and patient outcomes?
ai_method: A systematic review identified 32 randomized trials, with 27 meta-analyzed across workflow, engagement, and clinical-outcome tiers.
study_summary: Pooled estimates favored shorter workflows, better adherence, and lower all-cause mortality for decision-support implementations.

title: AI Guided Parenteral Nutrition Therapy After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
research_problem: Can AI standardize parenteral nutrition after hematopoietic transplantation?
ai_method: A supervised dosing model and reinforcement-learning policy use daily clinical states and a library of 30 nutrition regimens.
study_summary: Records from 1,473 TPN-treated adults covering 27,447 patient-days supported next-day dosing correlation near 0.71 and higher retrospective composite policy scores.

title: Deep learning-assisted versus manual reading in routine cervical cytopathology: a multicentre randomised crossover trial
research_problem: Does deep-learning assistance improve routine cervical cytology reading?
ai_method: Four less-experienced cytopathologists interpreted slides from 1,920 women in a multicenter randomized crossover reader study.
study_summary: Assistance improved sensitivity from 71.3% to 85.7%, preserved specificity, and substantially shortened reading time.

title: Integrating multimodal clinical data with a large model for prostate cancer diagnosis
research_problem: Integrate MRI, PSA and clinical text for heterogeneous prostate-cancer diagnosis.
ai_method: Prost-LM multimodal language model with shared cross-modal representations.
study_summary: The combined model outperformed an MRI-only comparator internally; clinical-use effectiveness was not established by diagnostic metrics.

title: Longitudinal assessment of chorea in Huntington’s disease using digital passive monitoring
research_problem: Track Huntington chorea during daily life rather than relying only on clinic ratings.
ai_method: Smartwatch accelerometry with a machine-learning score anchored to clinical chorea assessments.
study_summary: The score captured change over two years across four studies; the monitoring analysis itself was not a randomized treatment-effect evaluation.

title: AI Augmented Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy for Rapid Intraoperative Diagnosis of Brain Tumors
research_problem: Can confocal endomicroscopy accelerate intraoperative brain-tumor diagnosis, with AI support?
ai_method: A multicenter prospective study compared confocal imaging with frozen sections and developed a Swin-transformer diagnostic model.
study_summary: Among 461 biopsies from 376 patients, confocal accuracy was comparable with faster turnaround; AI achieved 0.94 tumor-detection and 0.88 subtype accuracy.

title: Development and prospective shadow evaluation of a domain-specific large language model for emergency neurological diagnosis
research_problem: Can a neurology-specific language model support emergency diagnosis?
ai_method: Xuanwu-NeuroAid underwent prospective shadow evaluation in 433 patients, with diagnosis comparison and blinded recommendation ratings.
study_summary: Model accuracy was 79.4% versus physicians’ 65.4%, and experts rated its recommendations more favorably; demographic inputs altered education advice.

title: Patch-to-slide fusion deep learning model for histological diagnosis of early pregnancy loss including hydatidiform mole
research_problem: Can slide-level AI distinguish early pregnancy-loss subtypes, including molar pregnancy?
ai_method: An adaptive-masking patch-to-slide fusion model combines histology and immunohistochemical stains.
study_summary: Multicenter data from 1,287 patients yielded independent-test accuracy 0.801 and AUROC 0.930; combined H&E/p57 models and AI assistance improved diagnostic performance.

title: Evaluating large language models for simplifying non-English medical consent with clinician involvement
research_problem: Can language models simplify Chinese surgical consent while retaining essential information?
ai_method: Forms from nine hospitals were compared in original, LLM-simplified, and clinician-revised versions using readability, quality, and lay comprehension assessments.
study_summary: LLM simplification improved comprehension but weakened risk-information quality; clinician revision restored accuracy and produced the strongest comprehension scores.

title: Artificial intelligence assisted colorectal lesion detection in private practices a randomized controlled study
research_problem: Does real-time polyp-detection AI improve adenoma detection in experienced outpatient practices?
ai_method: A multicenter randomized trial compared EndoMind-assisted and conventional colonoscopy across five centers and ten experienced examiners.
study_summary: Among 914 intention-to-treat participants, adenoma detection was 34.5% versus 32.9%, without a significant difference.

research_problem: Do correct and misleading AI explanations affect novice learners symmetrically?

title: Personalised health plan development using agentic AI in Singapore’s national preventive care programme: a pilot study
research_problem: Can a multi-agent assistant turn preventive-care recommendations into locally appropriate, personalized diet and exercise plans that residents and clinicians find usable?
ai_method: HealthGuide@Home uses agent collaboration, semantic routing and trusted local information to draft and iteratively customize preventive-health plans.
study_summary: Residents and clinicians generally rated appropriateness and usefulness above neutral, with favorable feedback on personalization. The pilot establishes preliminary acceptability rather than disease-prevention efficacy.

title: Predictive biomarkers of response to chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy for pan-haematologic cancer
research_problem: Can pan-cancer patient/cell measurements reveal general CAR-T response biomarkers?
ai_method: Informatics and machine-learning integration of clinical, flow-cytometry, manufacturing, serum and qPCR features.
study_summary: The study assembles a cross-trial resource to identify generalizable response and non-response features. Patients, source trials, T cells and repeated serum measurements are separate units and must not be combined into one sample total.

scope_reason: Machine learning is used to study clinical response to cancer immunotherapy.

research_question: Can pan-cancer patient/cell measurements reveal general CAR-T response biomarkers?
ai_approach: Informatics and machine-learning integration of clinical, flow-cytometry, manufacturing, serum and qPCR features.
primary_findings: The study assembles a cross-trial resource to identify generalizable response and non-response features. Patients, source trials, T cells and repeated serum measurements are separate units and must not be combined into one sample total.
limitations: Patients originate in 13 treatment trials; the present correlative modeling is not a new randomized AI-guided CAR-T trial or causal biomarker validation.

title: 3D Spatiotemporal cardiac reconstruction for predicting MACE in acute myocardial infarction
research_problem: Can dynamic 3D CMR representations improve long-term prognosis after myocardial infarction?
ai_method: ReconSeg3D reconstructs ventricular motion; HeartTTable uses spatiotemporal decomposition and cross-attention to combine images with 45 tabular variables.
study_summary: The reported five-year MACE AUC is 0.934 and C-index is 0.897, exceeding tabular-only comparators.

title: Real–time digital prescriptions unlock influenza dynamics: evidence from 21 million transactions
research_problem: Can real-time prescription activity provide earlier influenza surveillance and longer-range forecasts?
ai_method: Convergent cross-mapping assesses dynamical relationships, followed by GNN, Mamba and LSTM spatiotemporal forecasting.
study_summary: Analysis covers 21.08 million transactions across 31 provinces; prescriptions show a two-week lead and support a reported 96-day forecast horizon.

title: A scalable framework for evaluating health language models
research_problem: Can targeted Boolean rubrics make health-LLM evaluation more consistent and efficient?

study_summary: Metabolic-health evaluations show higher agreement and roughly half the rating time compared with conventional Likert scales.

title: Combining federated learning and travelling model boosts performance and opens opportunities for digital health equity
research_problem: Can federated and sequential model training jointly improve fairness across unequal imaging sites?
ai_method: FedTM warms up through federated learning and then sequentially refines a travelling model.
study_summary: Parkinson classification uses 1,817 scans from 83 sites; reported AUROC rises from 77% to 82%, with lower error disparities and smaller-site training load.

title: Deep learning for fast screening and localization of spinal dural arteriovenous fistulas to enhance clinical workflow
research_problem: Can AI shorten the CTA workflow for detecting and localizing spinal vascular fistulas?
ai_method: SDAVFdoc combines 3D segmentation, anatomical localization priors and DenseNet classification.
study_summary: The multicenter study includes 718 patients; reported detection AUC is 0.928–0.954 and image-processing time falls from about forty-one to one minute.

title: Wearable EEG devices in the detection of mild cognitive impairment: a systematic review
research_problem: How feasible and reliable are wearable EEG systems for detecting mild cognitive impairment?
ai_method: A systematic review examines devices, signal processing, extracted features and learning-based classification.
study_summary: Twenty-one studies cover sixteen devices, with accuracy ranging from 46% to 95%; ensemble learning and multimodal integration are among proposed design factors.

title: Sex disparities in deep learning estimation of ejection fraction from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
research_problem: Does a cardiac imaging foundation model estimate ejection fraction equally well by recorded sex?
ai_method: A pretrained CMR–report model is fine-tuned in UK Biobank and audited using masking, resampling and sex-informed adaptation.
study_summary: Reduced-ejection-fraction identification performs worse in females, and simple masking or resampling does not remove the disparity.

title: Remote digital cognitive assessment for aging and dementia using the Oxford Cognitive Testing Portal OCTAL
research_problem: Can remote cognitive testing detect dementia-related impairment across languages and ages?
ai_method: OCTAL combines digital cognitive tasks with machine-learning feature ranking, LASSO and random-forest diagnostic classifiers.
study_summary: Four validation studies cover 1,664 participants; the 194-person memory-clinic cohort supports discrimination of Alzheimer-type dementia from subjective cognitive decline.

title: Assessing the impact of safety guardrails on large language models using irritability metrics
research_problem: Do safety guardrails change language-model responses to irritability prompts?
ai_method: Four models with different guardrail levels completed three irritability instruments under baseline and provoked conditions.
study_summary: Lower-guardrail models increased irritability scores, whereas highly guarded models suppressed them, sometimes to zero.

title: A machine learning–enabled blood transcriptomic signature for digital diagnosis and subtyping of Alzheimer’s disease
research_problem: Can blood transcriptomic features complement plasma biomarkers for Alzheimer detection?
ai_method: Random-forest feature selection and partial-least-squares modeling derive a lactylation-related score, combined with phosphorylated tau.
study_summary: Across multiple datasets and a 540-person plasma cohort, score AUC fell from 0.897 in training to 0.772 clinically; the combined marker model reached 0.859.

research_problem: Can a generative gait model infer forces and modification effects from flexible inputs?
ai_method: GaitDynamics, a generative foundation model with flexible kinematic inputs and multiple outputs.
study_summary: The model estimates ground-reaction forces from complete or incomplete kinematics and predicts changes associated with gait modification or running speed. The authors share data, code and trained models. The accessible abstract does not state a unique participant total.

title: Noninvasive evaluation and clinical value prediction of tumor-infiltrating neutrophil-to-T-cell ratio in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
research_problem: Can noninvasive AI estimate a pancreatic-tumor immune ratio linked to prognosis?
ai_method: Seven models were evaluated using TCGA, CPTAC, and multicenter data, selecting the multimodal PORCELAIN region-based model.
study_summary: Externally estimated neutrophil-to-T-cell ratios stratified overall and recurrence-free survival and were associated with chemotherapy response.
